description: CentrePlan Downtown Sidewalks Upgraded is a dataset listed in City of Winnipeg open data portal (data.winnipeg.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Winnipeg. Efforts in 2025 were redirected in part to the pedestrian crossings at Portage and Main Source: City of Winnipeg Public Works Goal: improve sidewalk conditions and accessibility. Coverage: Winnipeg. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are transportation, sidewalk, downtown. The table has 2 columns. The portal shows 2026-05-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Canada Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-winnipeg-ca-portal.
